gaps.cause: Given one argument fewer for an optional or defaulted middle parameter, the reference shifts the remaining arguments left without checking their types and writes a call with an enum in the wrong slot (Players Within Radius(Up, 3, Off, Off), a beam whose colour is None). The native compiler rejects the call, which is the valid outcome.
Lowering rewrites False, True, 0 and an empty array to the parameter's canonical form before optimization, so a fold sees a different literal than the reference, which folds on what was written.
The catalog gives the slot of Create Dummy Bot no False/True coercion, so the optimizeForSize spelling the reference writes fails canonical validation.

validate_canonical_ids rejects values the reference writes: non-Boolean values in Boolean slots (the reference wraps some of them in First Of, others it leaves as they are) and arrays where Object is declared.
